name: Send Shopify Order Updates, Tracking Links, and WhatsApp Delivery Feedback Polls with Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Automate Shopify order updates, tracking links, and WhatsApp delivery feedback polls

### How it works

1. Listens for Shopify `orders/create`, `orders/fulfilled`, and `orders/cancelled` webhooks and sends instant order confirmations, carrier tracking links, and cancellation notices on WhatsApp via Supergreen without per-message fees or Meta template approvals.
2. Logs every order and status transition in Google Sheets and alerts Slack immediately when an order exceeds your high-value VIP threshold.
3. Runs a daily 10:00 sweep to send an interactive 3-option WhatsApp delivery feedback poll 72 hours after shipment.
4. Captures real-time poll votes to send a review link to happy buyers, escalate damaged or missing-item issues to Slack support, or resend tracking details and alert fulfillment on delayed packages.
5. Captures any unhandled runtime errors via Error Trigger and posts alerts to Slack.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the `n8n-nodes-supergreen` community node and connect your WhatsApp number on Supergreen.
- [ ] Add credentials for **Shopify Access Token**, **Supergreen API**, **Google Sheets OAuth2**, and **Slack OAuth2**.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with an `Orders` tab containing columns: `orderId`, `orderNumber`, `customerName`, `phone`, `email`, `total`, `items`, `status`, `trackingUrl`, `deliveryPollDueAt`, `pollSent`, `pollMessageId`, `updatedAt`.
- [ ] Replace `SET_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, `SET_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`, your store name, VIP threshold, and review URL in the configuration nodes and Slack error node.
- [ ] Enable phone number collection at Shopify Checkout so customer WhatsApp numbers are present on order payloads.

### Customization

Adjust `vipOrderThreshold` (default 250) and `deliveryPollDelayHours` (default 72) to match your average order value and carrier transit times, or swap Google Sheets for Airtable or Postgres.

## 1. Receive and normalize new orders

Captures Shopify orders/create webhooks, deduplicates retries, loads store settings, and extracts E.164 customer phone and VIP status.

## 2. Confirm order and check VIP threshold

Sends an instant WhatsApp confirmation via Supergreen, logs the order in Google Sheets, and checks whether total exceeds the VIP threshold.

## 3. Alert fulfillment on VIP orders

Posts a priority notification in Slack whenever a high-value order is placed.

## 4. Receive fulfillment and extract tracking

Captures Shopify orders/fulfilled events, deduplicates retries, and extracts carrier tracking details plus the 72h delivery poll due date.

## 5. Send tracking update and log shipment

Sends the live carrier tracking link on WhatsApp and updates the order row to Shipped in Google Sheets.

## 6. Receive and normalize cancelled orders

Captures Shopify orders/cancelled events and resolves the customer phone number and cancellation reason.

## 7. Notify customer of cancellation

Sends a cancellation and refund timeline message on WhatsApp and marks the order Cancelled in Google Sheets.

## 8. Find shipped orders due for check-in

Runs daily at 10:00, reads the Orders sheet, and selects shipped orders past their 72-hour delivery poll window.

## 9. Send WhatsApp delivery feedback poll

Sends an interactive 3-option WhatsApp poll via Supergreen and saves the pollMessageId for vote matching.

## 10. Match poll vote to Shopify order

Triggers on Supergreen vote events and retrieves the matching order row from Google Sheets by pollMessageId.

## 11. Validate choice and route outcome

Guards against empty unvotes or duplicate votes on already-resolved orders and routes by the customer's selected poll option.

## 12. Collect review from happy customer

Marks the order as Delivered - Happy in Sheets and sends a thank-you WhatsApp message with your review link.

## 13. Escalate delivery issue to support

Marks Issue Reported in Sheets, alerts your support team in Slack with order details, and reassures the customer on WhatsApp.

## 14. Follow up on delayed shipment

Marks the order Delayed in Sheets, resends the live tracking link on WhatsApp, and alerts fulfillment in Slack.

## 15. Alert Slack on workflow errors

Captures unhandled errors via Error Trigger and posts the failing node and error message to Slack.
